01运行前的观察目标02在单条轨迹内构造边界安全的窗口03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

输出 history 形状 (2,3,2)、target 形状 (2,4,1)。t=6 的标签为 [60,70,0,0]，后两步 Mask 为 False。

python 29_action-chunk_demo.py环境配置

在单条轨迹内构造边界安全的窗口

29_action-chunk_demo.py
import torch torch.manual_seed(7) # STEP 1: 每一行代表同一决策时刻的观测和待发送动作T, O, H = 8, 3, 4observations = torch.stack([torch.arange(T), torch.arange(T) + 100], dim=1).float()actions = (10 * torch.arange(T)).float().unsqueeze(-1) # STEP 2: 只允许在本轨迹内索引，越界位置填零并提供 maskdef make_window(t):    if not 0 <= t < T:        raise ValueError('current time outside episode')    obs_index = torch.arange(t - O + 1, t + 1)    act_index = torch.arange(t, t + H)    obs_valid = (obs_index >= 0) & (obs_index < T)    act_valid = (act_index >= 0) & (act_index < T)    obs = observations[obs_index.clamp(0, T - 1)]    act = actions[act_index.clamp(0, T - 1)]    obs = torch.where(obs_valid[:, None], obs, torch.zeros_like(obs))    act = torch.where(act_valid[:, None], act, torch.zeros_like(act))    return obs, act, obs_valid, act_valid # STEP 3: 检查轨迹开头和结尾，而不仅检查中间帧samples = [make_window(0), make_window(6)]history, target, history_mask, target_mask = [torch.stack(x) for x in zip(*samples)]assert history.shape == (2, O, 2)assert target.shape == (2, H, 1)assert history_mask[0].tolist() == [False, False, True]assert target_mask[1].tolist() == [True, True, False, False] # STEP 4: 执行长度是部署选择，不改变训练标签长度execution_horizon = 2commands_to_send = target[:, :execution_horizon]print('history:', history.tolist())print('target:', target.squeeze(-1).tolist())print('target mask:', target_mask.tolist())print('execute first steps:', commands_to_send.squeeze(-1).tolist())
